trial_court: 4th Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etawah, Criminal case No. 540/1990
case_name: Jagdish Chandra Dixit And Ors. vs Rabindra Dixit And Ors.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Jagdish Chandra Dixit, his wife Smt. Shanti and Narendra Deo

facts_of_case: Complainant Ravindra Dixit filed a complaint against his father Jagdish Chandra Dixit and others under Sections 494, 120B, and 109 of the IPC alleging that they were responsible for bringing him into mortal existence in July 1954. The complainants contracted a second marriage about four-five months after his birth.

legal_principles.principle: The applicability of Section 494, I.P.C. is ruled out if there is no prohibition in the personal Law.
legal_principles.held: If there is or was no such prohibition in the personal Law, the applicability of Section 494, I.P.C. would simply be ruled out.

legal_principles.principle: A Hindu male was not prohibited from contracting a second marriage even during the lifetime of the first wife prior to the coming into force of 'The Hindu Marriage Act' 1955.
legal_principles.held: Prior to the coming into force of 'The Hindu Marriage Act' 1955, a Hindu male was not prohibited from contracting a second marriage even during the lifetime of the first wife.

outcome.final_order: The court quashed the complaint giving rise to Criminal case No. 540/1990.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing a complaint under Section 482 CrPC
advising on the implications of bigamy in Hindu Marriage Act cases
assisting with prosecution strategies for criminal cases related to family law
